verdict.rationale: Pandoc is a locally run document-conversion CLI and Haskell library, not a hosted service that stores user data. Choosing a storage region or data residency is a cloud-service axis and does not apply to this kind of product. Its optional pandoc-server mode and online demos are not a managed storage offering with region selection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
